steps: Drag titlebar by 150px right and 100px down.
test_cases.actual: Window moved from (128,32) to (278,132).
Size increased from 680x458 to 780x538.

test_cases.actual: Display=none, state=minimized, taskbar count=1.
Window display=flex, state=open.

test_cases.actual: Display=none, state=closed, taskbar count=0.

steps: Open Welcome.doc, My Computer, and Media Player.
test_cases.expected: All three windows visible with taskbar buttons.
test_cases.actual: All three display=flex, taskbar count=3, z-indices increment.
Clock displays '12:21 AM'.
Menu display toggles between none and flex.
Popup opens on click and closes when clicking away.

steps: Click 'Turn Off Computer' in Start Menu.
test_cases.actual: Shutdown modal displayed=flex.
Modal display=none.
After 3.5s, stage display=flex opacity=1, desktop display=none.
Window shows Local Disk (C:), Data Disk (E:), floppy, CD drive, shared documents.

test_cases.description: Resume.doc content - no Cum Laude and IPK 3.73/4.00
test_cases.actual: No 'Cum Laude' found; IPK 3.73 / 4.00 visible.

test_cases.description: Dokumen Kerja folder and CV click
test_cases.expected: CV file shows; clicking opens PDF.
test_cases.actual: Folder lists CV_ATS_Andhika_Putra.doc. Clicking opens inline Document Viewer with CV text; no PDF/iframe opened.

test_cases.description: Gallery thumbnails visible and zoom controls work
test_cases.expected: Thumbnails visible; zoom controls change image scale.
test_cases.actual: Thumbnails load certificate_1-5.jpg. Zoom in sets scale(1.25); zoom out/reset return to scale(1).

test_cases.expected: Play toggles state, stop resets, prev/next switches tracks, volume updates.
test_cases.actual: Play/pause did not toggle (status remains Stopped). Prev/next updated track title. Volume slider updates display to 50%.

test_cases.expected: Dropdown changes project content; tabs switch active state and show corresponding section.
test_cases.actual: Dropdown options pumk/push both work; Developer and QA tabs activate and reveal their content.

steps: Type help, andhika, skills, contact, projects, clear.
test_cases.expected: Each command produces expected output; clear empties screen.
test_cases.actual: help lists commands; andhika, skills, contact, projects output correct text; clear results in empty output.
WebGL context present, canvas 1264x625, landing text 'SYSTEM ANALYST • WORKSTATION' visible.

steps: Click on the 3D computer monitor area.
test_cases.expected: XP preloader shows, then desktop loads.
test_cases.actual: Monitor click triggered boot animation, desktop appeared (note: re-boot after shutdown fails - see bug SD-001).

test_cases.description: Boot sequence: XP preloader then desktop
test_cases.actual: Preloader hidden by the time we query, but boot path dispatches xp:boot-desktop and desktop loads.

test_cases.expected: Correct window opens for each icon.
test_cases.actual: All icons open correct windows except cmd.exe which does nothing on click (direct openWindow works).
All start menu items map to existing windows; direct openWindow confirms targets work. Manual scripted clicks had timing variability.

test_cases.expected: Text switches between Indonesian and English.
test_cases.actual: Button changes ID/EN; sample i18n texts switch from 'Dokumen Kerja' to 'Work Docs', 'Sertifikat' to 'Certificates'.

test_cases.description: No JavaScript console errors during interaction
steps: Reload page, boot, open windows, click controls.
test_cases.actual: No console.error or unhandled exceptions observed with onerror and console.error hooks.

bugs.description: cmd.exe desktop icon click does not open the Command Prompt window. The icon has the correct data-open attribute, but clicking it has no effect.
reproduction: Actual: Nothing happens. Direct call to openWindow('win-cmd') works, so the window itself is functional but the icon's click handler is broken.

bugs.description: After shutdown returns to the 3D scene, clicking the monitor again does not reboot into Windows XP. The 3D scene is visible but no boot sequence is triggered.
reproduction: Open shutdown dialog and click 'Turn Off'.
Expected: Boot sequence starts and XP desktop reappears.
Actual: Nothing happens. Desktop remains hidden.

bugs.description: Windows Media Player play/pause button does not change playback state. Status text remains 'Stopped' and play icon stays visible after multiple clicks.
reproduction: Expected: Pause icon appears and status changes from 'Stopped' to 'Playing'.
Actual: Play icon remains and status stays 'Stopped'.

bugs.description: Search Rover (Search Companion) window referenced in JavaScript does not exist in the DOM. Search functionality is unreachable.
reproduction: Look for Search Rover window or search input.
Expected: A search window with #win-search and #rover-search-input is reachable.
Actual: No search window or input exists; JS references to #rover-search-input are dead code.
